title: potentilla caulescens subsp. djurjurae
intro: Potentilla caulescens subsp. djurjurae, commonly known as the Djurjura potentilla, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the rose family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of the Djurjura potentilla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
